UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile and theme preference stored per authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the workbench account menu.

email.description: Verified or provider-supplied email address (empty string if hidden by Apple private relay).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profile and synced theme preference document.
